skill.name: vercel-deployment
skill.description: Guidance for deploying Next.js applications to Vercel with environment, runtime, preview, and build optimization best practices.
skill.summary: Plan and troubleshoot production-ready Next.js deployments on Vercel.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Vercel deployments can fail because environment settings, runtimes, and build behavior differ across stages. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through practical Next.js deployment decisions.
actual_capabilities: Explains Vercel deployment stages for development, preview, and production.
Guides environment variable setup, including safe use of NEXT_PUBLIC_ values.
Compares Edge Runtime and Serverless Functions for API route decisions.
Identifies common deployment risks, including production database use in previews.
Suggests build optimization practices for faster deploys and smaller bundles.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not deploy projects by itself.
It focuses on Next.js applications and Vercel platform behavior.
It does not replace Vercel account permissions or project configuration access.
It cannot verify current Vercel limits without external documentation or account data.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Production Launch
use_cases.description: Plan environment variables, preview deployments, and runtime choices before moving a Next.js app to production.

use_cases.title: Review Deployment Risk
use_cases.description: Check whether previews, databases, caching, and public variables are configured safely for a release.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Slow Functions
use_cases.description: Analyze cold starts, bundle size, and runtime selection when Vercel functions behave poorly.

prompt_templates.title: Plan My First Deployment
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Next.js app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare a Next.js app for Vercel. Cover environments, previews, build settings, and common launch mistakes.

prompt_templates.title: Check Environment Variables
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review before preview or production deploys.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned Vercel environment variables. Identify which values are public, private, build-time, or runtime values.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Function Runtime
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Edge Runtime and Serverless Functions for my Next.js API routes. Include latency, Node.js support, and timeout tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Deployment Failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me diagnose a Vercel deployment failure. Ask for missing context, then check build output, environment scope, caching, and runtime limits.

output_examples.input: I need a checklist before shipping a Next.js app on Vercel.
output: Confirm production and preview environment variables are separate.
Verify no secrets use a public browser prefix.
Test preview deployments against non-production services.
Review function size, timeout behavior, and caching policy.

output_examples.input: My API route is slow after deployment.
output_examples.output: The skill would compare runtime choice, bundle size, cold start behavior, timeout limits, and any dependencies that block Edge Runtime use.

output_examples.input: Should preview deploys use my production database?
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend a separate preview database or isolated test data to reduce accidental production changes.

best_practices: Separate development, preview, and production environment variables.
Use preview deployments to test changes before production promotion.
Choose Edge or Serverless runtimes based on API needs and platform limits.
anti_patterns: Putting secrets in variables exposed to browser code.
Pointing preview deployments at the production database.
Ignoring build cache, bundle size, and cold start behavior.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy my app automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides deployment guidance that an agent or developer can apply with available tools.

faq.question: Is this skill only for Next.js?
faq.answer: It is mainly focused on Next.js applications deployed to Vercel.

faq.question: Can it help with environment variables?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains environment scope, preview separation, and safe public variable usage.

faq.question: Can it choose between Edge and Serverless runtimes?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares the tradeoffs around latency, Node.js APIs, timeouts, and function behavior.

faq.question: Does it replace Vercel documentation?
faq.answer: No. It is practical guidance and should be checked against current Vercel limits when precision matters.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
